2:265.text: And the likeness of those who spend their wealth seeking Allâh’s Pleasure while they in their ownselves are sure and certain that Allâh will reward them
, is the likeness of a garden on a height; heavy rain falls on it and it doubles its yield of harvest. And if it does not receive heavy rain, light rain suffices it. And Allâh is All-Seer

2:266.text: Would any of you wish to have a garden with date-palms and vines, with rivers flowing underneath, and all kinds of fruits for him therein, while he is striken with old age, and his children are weak
, then it is struck with a fiery whirlwind, so that it is burnt? Thus does Allâh make clear His Ayât
to you that you may give thought.

2:267.text: O you who believe! Spend of the good things which you have
earned, and of that which We have produced from the earth for you, and do not aim at that which is bad to spend from it,
you would not accept it save if you close your eyes and tolerate therein. And know that Allâh is Rich

2:268.text: threatens you with poverty and orders you to commit Fahshâ
; whereas Allâh promises you Forgiveness from Himself and Bounty, and Allâh is All-Sufficient for His creatures’ needs, All-Knower.

2:269.text: to whom He pleases, and he, to whom Hikmah is granted, is indeed granted abundant good. But none remember
